title: Ardoise
description: Conway's Game of Life on a school blackboard. Twelve chalk challenges — exact counts at the bell, doomed colonies to rescue, blackouts, and growth contests — each proven solvable, plus a free sandbox with the famous patterns: gliders, spaceships, the pulsar and Gosper's glider gun. Young chalk is white, old chalk turns yellow, births puff dust and deaths leave fading smudges. In English, French and Spanish.
controls: Tap or drag on the board to place chalk (or erase with the sponge) while life is paused; every flip costs one chalk stroke. Run, pause, or step one generation.
Space pauses, S steps one generation, R restarts a challenge (or rotates the selected pattern in the sandbox).
In the sandbox: pick a pattern, tap to stamp it, adjust speed 1-60 gen/s, sprinkle a random soup, toggle wrap-around edges.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
Rule by John Horton Conway (1937-2020); glider gun by Bill Gosper (1970).
